stem.text: Which statement correctly describes infectious diseases?

A.text: They are diseases caused by environmental factors that are not passed from one person to another.

B.text: They are diseases caused by a fault in the DNA that can be passed from a parent to their offspring.

C.text: They are diseases caused by a lack of a nutrient in the diet, such as a vitamin or mineral.

D.text: They are diseases caused by a pathogen such as a bacterium, fungus, protoctist or virus.
